title: The quality gate's answer
description: What the quality gate answers from an item's title and opening. The store keeps it whole as the output's answer, and keeps quality, side and side_confidence in the output's own columns. verdict and side are enums that ingestion matches on, never values taken from the text.

domains.description: One or two free-form labels for what the item is about.

themes.description: Short phrases naming what the item argues or explores.

quality.description: A rough estimate from 1 to 10 before any full read.

idea.description: One sentence stating the item's idea, kept where the item is dropped.

verdict.description: pass to a full read, drop, or unsure, which sends the item to a person.

reason.description: One sentence on why the gate gave its verdict, shown beside it to the person who judges it.
